visibility.textHeadline: Blog display modes per Sales Channel
visibility.visibilityModalDescription: “Hide in listing” will exclude the blog from blog overview listings but also from blog sliders and cross selling lists. Selecting the option “Hide in listing and search” will also exclude the blog from search actions. Blogs can still be reached via URL.
visibility.linkAdvancedVisibility: Set visibility for selected Sales Channels
visibility.bodyVisibility: Add Sales Channels in which this blog should be displayed. You may further define the blog visibility for each Frontend Sales Channel via the link below.

general.cloneNotice: The blog variants are duplicated. If this process is interrupted, it is possible that not all variants are duplicated completely. In this case you can generate the variants in the new blog again.

basicForm.hintCoverImageDescription: Begin the description with one or two short sentences describing the blog shown in the cover image. This improves accessibility and the presentation in blog listings.

blogNumberHelpText.label: Blog numbers help you identify and manage your blogs. To achieve this, try and keep a consistent structure in your blog numbers. You can define blog number templates in {link}.

highlightHelpText.label: Highlighted blogs are marked with a brightly coloured label and the word "Tip" in all blog listings. You can adjust the label's colour by changing the option "Notice" in {themeLink} settings. You can also alter the label's text by editing the corresponding {snippetLink}.

categoryForm.placeholderSearchKeywords: Enter keywords that find this blog...
categoryForm.textAddSearchKeyword: Click here to add search keyword
categoryForm.helpTextSearchKeyword: The blog in the Frontend can also be found using these keywords.
categoryForm.helpTextTags: Tags are meant for internal use only. They can help you manage groups of blogs, apply rules or serve as custom search terms.
categoryForm.descriptionCategories: Add categories so that the blog can be found via the Frontend main menu or by API connections. Make sure you select  categories that are available and active in the selected Sales Channel.
categoryForm.descriptionTags: Tags help you find blogs faster. They make it easier to group blogs and can be  utilised to automate task with the Rule Builder.

taxRateHelpText.label: Adjust the applicable VAT rate. A default VAT rate and up to two reduced rates are predefined for most countries. If you activated a tax provider the defined tax rate may be overwritten. You can check and alter the actual VAT rates or add additional rates and country assignments in {link}.

seoForm.labelCanonicalUrlMode: Use single canonical URL for all variants
seoForm.helpTextMetaTitle: The meta title is the most important SEO element and should be unique for each page. You should limit yourself in length to a maximum of 56 characters. Your keyword should ideally be placed at the very front.
seoForm.helpTextMetaDescription: With the meta description, you confirm to your users that they are in the right place in your store. You create incentives, build trust and invite to an action. You should limit yourself to a maximum of 155 characters. Contena allows a maximum length of 255 characters.
seoForm.helpTextKeywords: Here you can define optionally three to five keywords under which your blog should be found.
seoForm.helpTextOpenGraphTitle: The Open Graph title is used when sharing the blog on social media. If left empty, the meta title will be used as a fallback.
seoForm.helpTextOpenGraphDescription: The Open Graph description is used when sharing the blog on social media. If left empty, the meta description will be used as a fallback.

settingsForm.helpTextMaxPurchaseDigital: Leave it empty to use the maximum quantity from the cart settings.
settingsForm.helpTextAllowMultipleUnits: If multiple units aren't allowed, users can only buy one unit of the digital blog per order.
settingsForm.labelGuaranteeDescription: This label represents a commercial guarantee of durability expressed in years. The guarantee is offered by the producer at no additional costs, covering the entire good and with a duration of more than two years.
settingsForm.helpTextGuaranteeConfirmed: The guarantee label is only displayed if a valid guarantee duration, a manufacturer and the manufacturer blog number is set.
settingsForm.helpTextGuaranteeTermsMedia: The producer's guarantee statement. It is linked below the label in the Frontend and attached to the order confirmation email.
settingsForm.helpTextGuaranteeTermsUrl: Optional web page with the guarantee terms. If set, it is linked instead of the PDF.
settingsForm.labelActive: Active for all selected Sales Channels
settingsForm.noticeGuaranteeRequirements: The label will not be displayed in the Frontend until the following information is stored:

measurementForm.description: Enter blog measurements in your preferred units. Contena converts them for users based on the {link}.

packagingForm.description: Set the selling units and packaging details users see in the frontend.
packagingForm.helpTextBasicUnit:
Required to calculate the blog's unit price. The base value to be entered depends on the selected scale unit.
  • Unit price = (blog price * basic unit) / selling unit.
Unit price not displayed, if selling unit and basic unit have the same value.
packagingForm.helpTextPackUnit: Type of packing: e.g. bottle, crate, tin...
packagingForm.helpTextPackUnitPlural: Type of packing (plural): e.g. bottles, crates, tins...
packagingForm.helpTextSellingUnit:
Required to calculate the blog's unit price. The value to be entered depends on the selected scale unit.
  • Unit price = (blog price * basic unit) / selling unit.
Unit price not displayed, if selling unit and basic unit have the same value.
